# Walgreens

> > Walgreens is a comprehensive pharmacy and health retail platform offering prescription management, wellness services, vaccinations, and photo services.

Walgreens.com is the digital storefront for one of the largest pharmacy chains in the United States, providing customers with access to prescription services, health information, order tracking, and wellness products. The site integrates pharmacy operations, telehealth services, rewards programs, and retail shopping into a unified healthcare and wellness destination.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacy Services
- Prescription Management
- Vaccination Scheduling
- Health & Wellness
- Walgreens Rx Savings Finder
- RxSense
- Virtual Healthcare
- Medicare
- Rewards Program
- Drug Information
- Order Tracking
- COVID-19
- Flu Services
- Beauty Products
- Guest Checkout

## Pharmacy & Prescription Services

- [Drug Information](https://www.walgreens.com/rx-druginfo/pharmacy/finddrug/druginfosearch): Comprehensive drug information database with details on Rx and OTC medications, interactions, and usage guidelines

## Shopping & Account Management

- [Walgreens Homepage](https://www.walgreens.com): Main Walgreens.com portal with access to pharmacy, health, wellness, and photo services
- [Order History & Lookup](https://www.walgreens.com/orderhistory/orders-ui): Guest order lookup and purchase details tracking for monitoring order history and status
